newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering forecasts strong sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Schering forecasts strong sales growth.

text.p: German drug company Schering AG said it plans to increase turnover by developing its therapeutics and its hormone preparation business, and said its diagnostic business is not expected to grow at the same rate.

Guenter Stock, chairman of the Berlin-based pharmaceutical group, said late on Monday that sales of drugs against multiple sclerosis, leukaemia, strokes and Alzheimer's disease would double in the next eight years.
One problem that Stock foresaw with this was that research and development in this area was riskier and more expensive than in the diagnostic area.
